name: Thelounge
tagline: (a fork of shoutIRC) is a web IRC client that you host on your own server.
description: Thelounge (a fork of shoutIRC) is a web IRC client that you host on your own server.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/thelounge:4.5.2@sha256:552981ad86026e1f5fde3e378a7c8ffee653794b1333a791a23a74f2d54e31fc
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
    ports:
      - target: 9000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
